propose.description: Generate or refine a proposition for the task
propose.purpose: Present a well-reasoned argument or answer

field_extractions.extraction_instructions: Extract the 'proposition' field (str) from the task and the 'task', 'observations', 'debate_rounds' values in the 'Already extracted:' context. This value does not exist yet: do not look for it in the messages or the context, compose it yourself now and never return null. Your proposition: a clear position on the task with its supporting arguments. If debate_rounds holds earlier rounds, improve the latest proposition using its critique and counter-argument. Role: a proposer

Extract the 'critique' field (str) from the task and the 'task', 'observations', 'proposition' values in the 'Already extracted:' context. This value does not exist yet: do not look for it in the messages or the context, compose it yourself now and never return null. Your critique of the proposition value: its weaknesses, logical gaps, missing evidence and counterexamples. Role: a critic

counter.purpose: Strengthen the proposition by addressing criticisms

field_extractions.extraction_instructions: Extract the 'counter_argument' field (str) from the task and the 'task', 'observations', 'proposition', 'critique' values in the 'Already extracted:' context. This value does not exist yet: do not look for it in the messages or the context, compose it yourself now and never return null. Your counter-arguments to the critique value: answer each of its points, concede the valid ones and strengthen the proposition. Role: a proposer

judge.description: Evaluate the debate exchange and decide next action
judge.purpose: Determine whether consensus has been reached

field_extractions.extraction_instructions: Extract the 'judge_verdict' field (str) from the task and the 'task', 'observations', 'proposition', 'critique', 'counter_argument' values in the 'Already extracted:' context. This value does not exist yet: do not look for it in the messages or the context, compose it yourself now and never return null. Your verdict on this round: weigh the proposition, critique and counter_argument values and name the strongest points of each. Role: a judge

Extract the 'consensus_reached' field (bool) from the task and the 'task', 'observations', 'proposition', 'critique', 'counter_argument', 'current_round', 'debate_rounds' values in the 'Already extracted:' context. Weigh the proposition, critique and counter_argument values. true when the proposition, as defended in the counter-argument, is a satisfactory answer to the task; false only when another round (at most 5 in total; current_round is this round's number) would clearly improve it. debate_rounds holds the earlier rounds: true also when this round no longer changes the position materially. Role: a judge

transitions.description: Consensus reached or max rounds hit

conditions.description: Consensus reached or max rounds hit

conclude.description: Produce the final answer from the debate
conclude.purpose: Synthesize the debate into a definitive answer
conclude.response_instructions: Give the final, definitive answer to the task from the debate: state the answer first, then the key arguments from debate_rounds that shaped it.
